children: U.S. President Donald Trump said U.S. military action has given the United States full control of the Strait of Hormuz and that oil shipments through the waterway are now above levels seen before the Iran war began. According to Odaily, Trump also said Russia has agreed to supply the United States with large volumes of petroleum products, mainly diesel, and urged U.S. refiners and retailers to lower fuel prices immediately. He said the United States has provided ample oil supply, while noting that his remarks have not been independently verified.

title: U.S. President Donald Trump Says Strait of Hormuz Oil Shipments Exceed Prewar Levels, Urges U.S. Oil Firms to Cut Prices
